reasons.text: The legible label photo shows model 34785, which is a recalled model.
The label date code 10/2021 falls within the recalled range 10/2021-12/2022.
Igloocoolers.com is on the list of retailers, and the purchase date 2023-06-04 is inside the sale window. No receipt is required for this retailer.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this claim.
The claimant requested repair or replacement, not a refund, so the value threshold does not apply. The serial check was skipped and is not needed for this decision.
